facts.fact: The Nigerian Communications Commission, through its Joint NCC-Industry Committee, issued a consultation paper on 19 June 2026 inviting stakeholders to send written comments by 9 July 2026 on the framework for zero-rated access to educational platforms for students (structure, eligibility, funding, net neutrality, competition safeguards).
facts.system: Zero-Rated Access to Educational Platforms framework (Zero-Rated Data Access Project)

systems.system: Joint NCC-Industry Committee on the Implementation of Zero-Rated Access to Education Platforms
systems.country_label: Committee constituted by the NCC with key industry players that issued the consultation paper; members from outside government not named, so no body fact
